excerpt: Shogun is a no-code page builder, A/B testing and personalisation tool for Shopify and BigCommerce stores. Page Builder plans run from a free Draft Mode to $499/month.
content:
Shogun helps online stores build and improve their pages without writing code. Its main product, Page Builder, is a drag-and-drop editor for Shopify and BigCommerce stores: merchants use it to customise their store's design and build pages visually instead of editing their theme's code. Shogun also sells A/B testing, so a store can split traffic between two versions of a page to see which sells better, and personalisation, which shows different content to different shoppers.

Finbarr Taylor is a co-founder of Shogun. In November 2018 Pulse 2.0 reported that Shogun, then led by Taylor as CEO, raised a $2.1 million seed round from Initialized Capital, Y Combinator and others, and had more than 6,000 clients. In June 2021 the company announced a $67.5 million Series C led by Insight Partners, with existing investors Initialized Capital, Accel and VMG Partners taking part, bringing its total funding to $114.5 million. At the time Shogun said it was trusted by more than 18,000 customers, including K-Swiss, Leesa, Rumpl, Beardbrand, MVMT and Fila, and that it also offered Shogun Frontend, a headless commerce product, which it planned to use the money to develop.

Shogun publishes prices. For Shopify, Page Builder has a free Draft Mode for exploring the builder, then Build at $39 a month, Grow at $199 and Advanced at $499, with about 20% off for annual billing. A/B testing and personalisation are priced separately and charged partly by monthly tracked users (each unique shopper who sees a page with an active test or personalised experience). Paid plans can be tried before you pay.

This profile draws on Shogun's own pages and published reporting. We have not tested the product, and nothing here is paid placement.
